description: This file defines the exception class 'S3MultipartUploadException' used specifically for handling multipart upload errors in AWS S3 service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends a more general MultipartUploadException and adds methods to retrieve bucket, key, and source filename information related to the upload state when an exception occurs.

classes.name: S3MultipartUploadException
classes.description: An exception class specific to AWS S3 multipart upload errors, providing methods to access upload details such as bucket, key, and filename.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the name of the S3 bucket associated with the upload error, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the object key associated with the upload error, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getSourceFileName
methods.description: Returns the source file name involved in the upload, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: collectPathInfo
methods.description: Internal method to extract and set bucket, key, and filename information from the command object when accessible.
